proof_scope: the pre-submit ChatGPT DOM doctor: verdict/drift/cross-run-baseline logic (positive + adversarial) and its wiring into the submit flow, as a reliability + regression guard

claims.proves: preflightDoctor returns PROCEED on a healthy page, flags in-run selector drift, returns STOP_HANDOFF on logged-out/composer-gone/rate-limited, RETRY_AFTER_RELOAD on cloudflare, and records cross-run baseline drift; and that the doctor stays wired BEFORE typePrompt with a fail-fast throw and no captcha-solving
claims.does_not_prove: an authenticated live WebGPT completion end-to-end, or that real-world lane failure rate dropped (needs a live seat)

capability_claims.description: Surf verifies ChatGPT submit targets before typing, diagnoses selector drift (in-run and cross-run), fails fast on blocking states, and never solves a captcha.
